12-lead ECG on admission: sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 71
bpm, PR interval 160 ms, QRS 103 ms, QTc 419 ms. Sinus rhythm with occasional prernature
atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction cstimated at
40%. Trace mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Moderately reduced left ventricular systolic function.
